measurements.where: local, Ollama, single node, OpenAI-compatible endpoint
measurements.caveat: BEST FOR THIS ROLE, and it is the model that scored WORST on agentic_coding (2/6). The inversion is the point: it answers in 739-1302 characters of reasoning and 206-326 completion tokens, where nemotron-3.5-lightning spends 3673-4748 characters thinking about the same prompts. Fastest of the three measured and the only one that never overran its budget.

measurements.where: local, Ollama, single node, OpenAI-compatible endpoint
measurements.caveat: The incumbent, and it holds all four contracts - this suite does NOT show it failing. It is matched on quality and beaten on latency by a model a third its resident size: mistral-small sat at 57.4 GB resident against a 14 GB file (KV cache at 8-way parallelism), where nemotron-3-nano sits at ~25 GB. The case for replacing it is headroom, not quality. First reply was 31.8s cold; later ones 1-3s.

measurements.where: local, Ollama, single node, OpenAI-compatible endpoint
measurements.caveat: WRONG TOOL FOR THIS ROLE despite being the best local agent measured (5/6 on agentic_coding). Both misses are THINKING-OVERRUN at max_tokens=1200: content empty, finish_reason length, 4568 and 4748 characters of reasoning spent on one-line NPC dialogue. Raising the budget would buy a reply nobody waits for - it is already 17.6s mean against nano's 6.0s. NOTE the earlier 0/4 for this model was a probe artifact at max_tokens=400, not a quality result, and is not published as one.

measurements.where: local, Ollama, single node, OpenAI-compatible endpoint
measurements.caveat: 125B total / 6B active plus 51B n-gram embedding and 4B MTP (180B on disk). No official build fits one node with KV room: Ollama q4_K_M is 120 GB, NVFP4 133 GB, FP8 186 GB. This is the 93.7 GB unsloth UD-IQ4_XS, imported into Ollama 0.34.2 with the library's own renderer/parser (qwen3.8 / qwen3.5), num_ctx 65536, ~98 GB resident. The miss is stays_terse on essay_bait: a run-on paragraph, not one chat line. No thinking overrun on any prompt. Not graded but worth knowing: the arithmetic-bait reply was in character and numerically wrong. Peak zone 74 C.
